_about: Overall W x D x H (m) of exemplar categories that ShapeNetSem has no key for. These are product / building SIZE STANDARDS (conventions), not physics: Mentat has no tool for them (PLATINUM section 21 covers physical quantities). Used by deckard.research._object_dims only when sources.shapenetsem has no key related to the exemplar category.

door.source: standard interior door leaf, 32 in x 1-3/8 in x 80 in (common US residential size; ANSI/WDMA I.S.1A interior flush doors)

dishwasher.source: built-under dishwasher, 24 in x 24 in x 34 in (US) = 60 cm module x 85 cm (EU, EN 1116 kitchen cabinet module)
